user.description: At least one of id, email and phone.

anonymized.description: Records kept without the person's details.

user.description: At least one of id, email and phone.

records.description: The person's records by kind (each product names its own; staff: the kit's staff records).

The Format of money and dates

schema.description: The fields to change; null resets a field.

post.description: Notes derives nothing from imported notes.

get.summary: What the import holds now (ss-import verify)

post.description: collection is notes (404 not_found for another). Send application/x-ndjson, one note per line ({ id, text, email?, createdAt }), at most 1,000 records or 4 MB per call (413 payload_too_large; 415 unsupported_media_type). Each note is written by its id and replaces the stored one, so running it again changes nothing. Nothing is sent.

schema.description: What was (or, in a dry run, would be) written.

id.description: The note's id (null when the line is not a record).

path.description: A JSON Pointer in the record.

post.summary: Remove imported notes the source no longer has
post.description: Removes the notes an import wrote whose id lies after after and up to through (open ends when left out) and is not in keep, at most 1,000 per call (more: true: call again). Send the source’s ids sorted (byte order of their UTF-8), cut into calls. Only notes an import wrote are removed: notes left on the website stay. 422 validation_failed for keep; 413 payload_too_large over 1,000 ids.

keep.description: The note ids the source has in this range.

removed.description: In a dry run: how many would go.

keys.description: The ids removed (in a dry run: the first 1,000 that would go).

more.description: More notes of the range are to be removed: call again.

value.description: The saved list, else its default (each product describes its lists).

put.summary: Save a whole list setting ({ value })

post.description: A visitor leaves a note. A text longer than the maxLength setting answers 422 validation_failed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own per request: the same request again within 24 hours gets the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true); another request with it answers 409 duplicate_request.

text.description: Trimmed; at most the maxLength setting.

get.summary: Settings schemas, and values of switched-on features

features.description: Each feature's settings, then the settings several features share.

schema.description: The settings' JSON Schema (from the manifest).

values.description: Setting → { value, source }; null while the feature is off.

delete.summary: Reset one setting to the default

put.description: The feature must be on (else 403 feature_off); an invalid value answers 422 validation_failed with errors.

value.description: A value the setting's schema allows (not null: DELETE resets).

delete.summary: Reset one widget text to English

put.description: 1–2000 characters with the same {placeholders} as the English text.

schema.description: The fields to change; null resets a field.

post.summary: Ticket for an admin widget (15 minutes)
post.description: Your server asks for a ticket for the member of your staff who opens an admin widget. Permissions of switched-off features are left out of the ticket.

origin.description: The https origin of the page that shows the widget (a local origin while testing).

ticket.description: Give it to the admin widget (data-ticket).

get.description: The same for the admin widgets, with a ticket from POST /v1/tickets, from the origin it names.

With the browser token from the website (an Origin is required; the server token is refused): what the visitor widgets need. No feature of its own: it answers while the product serves the website and its merchant database is connected.

browserToken.description: The website's browser token: visitor routes, from https://<exact domain> or a local origin.

serverToken.description: The website's server token: the merchant's server only, never with an Origin header. It also reaches every visitor route, acting for the visitor named by SS-Visitor-IP (and SS-Sign-In).

ticket.description: A ticket from POST /v1/tickets: admin widgets, only from the origin it names.

SSVisitorIp.name: SS-Visitor-IP
SSVisitorIp.description: With the server token: the visitor's IP address (required on writes, else 400 visitor_ip_required). These calls count in their own window of 3,000 requests per minute per route per website, plus the per-visitor limits.

SSActorId.name: SS-Actor-Id
SSActorId.description: With the server token: the member of your staff the call acts for (1–64 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ . : @ -).

SSActorName.name: SS-Actor-Name
SSActorName.description: The acting member's name, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 120 characters (with SS-Actor-Id).

SSActorRole.name: SS-Actor-Role
SSActorRole.description: The acting member's role, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 40 characters.

action.description: What was done, for example payment.refunded.

target.description: The id of what it was done to.

label.description: A name for the target, for example an order number.

values.description: What changed as codes, numbers and yes/no, which the product's texts put into words ({} when none).

Actor.description: Who did it: user (the acting user of a server call), staff (a ticket's user) or server.

Connection.description: A connection as screens see it: secrets never come back.

last4.description: The last 4 characters of the secret ('' when none).

Count.description: How many records match the list's filters.

capped.description: True when there are more than 100,000 (count is then 100,000).

Counts.description: The matching records counted by one field.

groups.description: Value → count, the 50 largest groups; a missing value is counted as none.

locale.description: A language tag such as en-US or fr-FR, or '' for the viewer's (en-US in text the server makes).

currencySymbols.description: The merchant's own symbol per currency (ISO 4217 code → symbol), used with currencyDisplay symbol; a currency without one shows the locale's symbol.

NotePage.description: One page of notes, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page.

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457, application/problem+json). The last segment of type is a stable code, for example validation_failed.

requestId.description: Quote it when you contact support.

errors.description: validation_failed: what is wrong, field by field.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the field, for example /amount.

colors.description: Color name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

ValueSource.description: Where a value comes from: saved for this website, the global default, or built in.

WidgetConfig.description: What the product's widget.js needs for a website.

texts.description: Widget texts by key, in the website's words (else the product's English defaults); fill their {placeholders} as text, never as HTML.

colors.description: Color name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

customCss.description: The merchant's own CSS for the widgets (at most 20 kB).

locale.description: A language tag such as en-US or fr-FR, or '' for the viewer's.

currencySymbols.description: The merchant's own symbol per currency (ISO 4217 code → symbol), used with currencyDisplay symbol; a currency without one shows the locale's symbol.

timeZone.description: The business time zone (business.json), default UTC.

widgets.description: The keys of the widgets whose feature (one, or any of a list) is on: a widget not listed renders nothing.

settings.description: The product's own widget settings (never secrets).
